sentences.en: The lecturer couldn't get his message across to the audience.
sentences.zh: 这位讲师没能把他的观点传达给观众。

sentences.en: The lecturer dwelt on some memories of his college days.
sentences.zh: 这位讲师详细回忆了他大学时代的某些往事。

sentences.en: Because the lecturer speaks quickly few people could follow him.
sentences.zh: 由于讲师说话太快，很少有人能跟上他的思路。

senses.zh: （大学或学院中的）讲课者，授课者，（英美大学中的）讲师,演讲者
